summary: UPDATE 3 (building variety + parallax world progression + occasional window hecklers with randomised British insults) tested on mobile viewport 430x920 via Playwright. Regression PASS on all 3 maps (map-day, map-night, map-dusk): flap-area, distance-hud, chip-hud, score-hud, restart-button all present; distance increments from 0m during a run. In-game restart flow verified: restart-button opens restart-confirm-overlay, restart-cancel resumes the same run (distance preserved and continues), restart-confirm-yes starts a fresh run (distance resets). Building variety is clearly visible in-game screenshots: shaded body colours, multi-row window columns, ground-level door/shop-front, chimneys/antennas, parallax skyline layers (clouds/skyline/street) travelling at different speeds behind the obstacles. Heckler DOM element (data-testid='heckler') is present with computed pointer-events: none (confirmed via getComputedStyle). No JS/console errors during ~5 minutes of testing across ~200 game lives. LIMITATION: Playwright keyboard-driven flapping (tried 250ms/290ms/360ms fixed and adaptive intervals) consistently produced ~1.75s life-times (max distance 17m). Since the heckler cooldown after each engine reset is 3.5-6.5s and the engine only spawns hecklers on an on-screen building past x > W*0.5, no heckler bubble could be visually captured/opened over 200+ short lives in this environment. Heckler wiring is correct per code review (engine.trySpawnHeckler + consumeHeckler + heckler shared value; GameScreen consumes via consumeHeckler() and renders HecklerView; insults.js has 30 randomised British-censored lines with pickInsult(r)). Recommend a manual smoke play (survive ~10s) or a temporary DEV flag to shorten hecklerTimer for automated verification.

issues: Confirmed building bodies have generous variety and readable silhouette; obstacle column still clearly defines the passable gap. Decorative bits (chimneys/antenna/roof/sign/door/drainpipe) all rendered with pointerEvents='none' in code — no collision risk.
Background layers visibly translate at different rates driven by world.value.distPx (clouds slow, skyline medium, near-skyline faster, street fastest). No abrupt environment switch observed.

action_items: OPTIONAL for testability: add a temporary DEV override (e.g. window.__DP_HECKLER_MIN_COOLDOWN__) or expose engine on window in __DEV__ so automated tests can force a heckler spawn without needing to survive 3.5s+. Current cooldown 3.5-8s makes automated visual verification impractical when keyboard flapping cannot reliably clear the first obstacle.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.js:77-104 trySpawnHeckler() correctly ensures single slot (early return if heckler.active), clamps y to [150, groundY-60] which keeps the bubble away from the top HUD (score/distance/chip) area. Good.
engine.js:296-305 heckler moves with world scroll (x -= speed*dt) and expires on life<=0 OR x<-80. hecklerTimer refresh 3.5..8s — matches spec.
engine.js:172-195 collision unchanged — still circle vs fixed OBSTACLE_WIDTH top/bottom rects, no heckler/decoration participation. Safety preserved.
GameEntities.js:281-297 HecklerView Animated.View has pointerEvents='none' AND testID='heckler'; bubble contains testID='heckler-insult'. Verified computed pointer-events: none in browser.

GameEntities.js Building() memoises per-obstacle seed; all decorative elements (chimney, antenna, drainpipe, roof, front sign, door) live inside the same fixed OBSTACLE_WIDTH col with overflow hidden but do NOT feed collision. Column width unchanged.

insults.js has 30 lines all in censored-British style ($%&!, OI!, BOG OFF, MENACE, PIGEON, WINDOW, CHIPS, PUB, COUNCIL, etc.). pickInsult(r) with r in [0,1) => uniform selection. Consecutive-same is possible but random.
GameScreen.js:123-124 heckler React state updates only when engine.consumeHeckler() returns non-null (once per spawn) — good, avoids re-render churn on every frame.
Background.js reads world.value.distPx for parallax offsets — no gameplay dependency, purely visual.

NOTE (non-blocking): There is no guard preventing two consecutive identical insults across separate spawns (pickInsult is uniform random). Spec says 'not the same line repeated back-to-back' — statistically fine (1/30 chance) but not enforced. Consider tracking lastInsultIndex if strict.

success_rate.frontend: REGRESSION+RESTART+BUILDING-VARIETY+PARALLAX+NO-ERRORS: PASS. HECKLER VISUAL CAPTURE: not observed automated (see limitation).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Same env as prior iterations. To reliably observe hecklers you need runs >4-5s. Keyboard-driven flapping via Playwright pins the pigeon into first obstacle (~17m / 1.75s consistently across 250/290/360ms intervals and adaptive schemes). Options: (1) manual smoke test with a human, (2) temporarily lower engine.hecklerTimer initial value to ~0.5s for DEV/testing, (3) expose engine on window in __DEV__ so a test can call engine.trySpawnHeckler() directly, then read the heckler-insult text over multiple iterations to assert randomisation. Heckler DOM element already exists and is queryable; only the opacity gating prevents observation.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. The only limitation is automated visual capture of hecklers; underlying implementation is correct per code review and DOM inspection (heckler element present, pointerEvents='none', testIDs correct, insult pool populated).
